name: Near Mint
description:
About This Game

Near Mint is a roguelike deckbuilder where you play a deck of torn cards, and recompose them at will to create unique and powerful effects. Explore perilous paths and face off against dangerous foes to discover the secrets of the Mint.

Craft hundreds of combos to fight your way through the dark memories of this world. Adapt against every threat that stands in your way and reassemble the fragments of your cards... and of the world's past.

Torn Cards

The cards you collect have been ripped into pieces! Recompose them each turn, allowing you to create unique effects, forge powerful combos and adapt to each challenge your foes present.

Dark Fantasy

The Gods have withdrawn. The world aches. Yet it does not die, locked in a state of perpetual agony. Find your path and prevail against its many threats in your search for a way to restore the illusory Mint... or simply for your own survival.

 

 

Forsaken Heroes

Each one comes with a unique deck and will lend you their strength and insights as you, in turn, guide them through their respective quests for closure.

Near Mint is a dream that features hundreds of cards, deep progression and a dive into a world full of abominations and forsaken heroes.
short_desc: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.
